parsed.explanation: Elevated-low risk. Traveller-facing state measures are the main problem: top-court/statutory code treats sex as biological for single-sex services; transport stop/search and regional policing use birth-sex searches, with prison custody similarly contested; hospital ward-exclusion plans and a reported death after trans-related ward removal show care denial can be severe. These universal or near-universal exposures mean discovery can bring exclusion, humiliation, misgendered searches/custody, with no documented effective remedy yet. Offsets: no trans-specific criminalisation, continued gender-reassignment discrimination protection, partial hate-crime laws, functioning courts, some LGBT acceptance and mixed subnational regimes. But institutional hostility and recent hostile media/culture keep it low elevated.
